source: FBR Circular No. 02 of 2026-27 · Section 182 · Finance Act 2026
headline: SCANNED ACCOUNTS
NOW COUNT AS

items: **Image or scanned accounts:** treated as blank or incomplete
**Companies:** accounts in an **electronically readable** file from tax year 2026
**Excess withholding credit claimed:** penalty equals the excess
**Required electronic resource missing:** **1% of turnover** or **Rs 1 million**, whichever is higher
